verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents Grok driving a web browser to navigate sites or complete tasks on them. The closest items are Grok Bot's 'persistent cloud computer', which never mentions browser operation, plus multi-agent research and OAuth/MCP connectors. These are related but different features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites
